title: Rootwise estimates for Weyl alternants
summary: For a reduced crystallographic root system with Weyl group $W$, Weyl alternants are signed sums of exponentials indexed by $W$. They occur in the numerators of the Weyl character formula and the explicit formula for spherical functions on complex semisimple groups. We establish rootwise bounds that quantify cancellation in these oscillatory sums, with each positive root contributing a factor depending on both the spatial variable and the spectral parameter.
